concern_summary: This concern encompasses the functionalities related to processing and managing requests for physical Expensify cards, specifically focusing on the deletion confirmation and user interactions through a popup interface.
This concern focuses on the delete confirmation process for saved searches, involving the display of a confirmation modal to ensure intentional user action before proceeding with the deletion.
This concern addresses the deletion logic of money requests, including managing the associated reports and cleanup of related data when a request is deleted.
This concern encompasses the actions related to money requests, specifically focusing on confirming, approving, and deleting requests while ensuring proper permissions and validations.
This concern encompasses the management of popup displays, including the visibility and behavior of both general popups and context-specific menus that respond to user interactions and permissions.
This concern focuses on handling join requests, including the management of pending requests, processing user actions on those requests, and ensuring proper authorization and state updates.

This concern deals with evaluating and managing request actions associated with transactions and user permissions, ensuring that requests are valid and that users have the necessary access to perform them.

This concern encompasses functionalities for handling payment requests and various types of money requests, processing their statuses, managing notifications, and ensuring the correct handling of different request types.
This concern focuses on popup menus, handling their display, visibility, and interaction based on user actions and permissions.
